senses.gloss: m. (= מסיפסף; סוּף; cmp. פְּסִיפָּס, פִּסְפָּס with which our w. interchanges) border-mark, partition consisting of wooden or stone pegs, contrad. to מחיצה or כותל partition wall.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 72a">Erub. 72ᵃ</cite> (Ms. O. twice <he>פסיפס</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 10), opp. to <he>מחיצה עשרה</he> a partition ten hand-breadths high.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 2b:4">B. Bath. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>במ׳ בעלמא</he> (Ms. M. <he>בפְסִיסִין</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) where there are only pegs as border marks, opp. <cite ref="K00428"><he>כותל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 70b">Ab. Zar. 70ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. V, 44ᵈ bot. <he>חצר החלוקה במ׳</he> a court which is divided off by mere marks (cmp. <cite ref="M01862"><he>מְסוּגִין</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 8:22">Tosef. Sabb. VIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 9:22">IX</cite>), 22 [read:] <he>כדי לעשותו מ׳</he>) Var. ed. Zuck. (ed. <cite ref="M01878"><he>מסופות</he></cite>) large enough to be used for a marking peg.—Pl. <he>מְסִיפְסִין</he>.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 422:1">Yalk. Ex. 422</cite> [read:] <he>כמין מ׳ היו עשויות מלמעלה</he> a sort of marks were on top (to distinguish between the Holy and the Holy of Holies; ib. 370 <he>כמין פספסין היה וכ׳</he>).
